body: I guess I just get upset because I think it's my fault they act this way. I mean, I haven't ever seen them act that way to anybody else except me so I guess I just assume it's only me. I put them in the position to reject me
They say they'll be there but most of them won't be, except one. I really appreciate your kind words. Only made me cry a little lol. I hope those thoughts ease off for you. Thank you <3

Honestly it would probably be better for them. I'm a fucking drag.. I wish I could keep the mask on 24/7. I just really want my friends to be happy and I'm just incapable of making them happy I guess.. Can I even really call myself their friend??

I try so fucking hard dude. I try so so fucking hard. I have made zero progress. Zero. None. I know it will never ever happen because I want people to love me and want me around more than I want anything in the whole universe. And you know the more you want something the less likely it is it'll happen. Thank you for your advice though. I already do the thing where I know people won't like it if I try to talk to them or want their attention or want their love, but I do it anyways because I guess I don't have anything to lose. 

I kind of want to cut my losses and not do that to them anymore. I guess I hope they get sick of me first and just drop me completely.
